text:
ana: kicking off preflight for the 23:59 UTC cutover. Targets: api v2.8.0, runtime 3.5.0-quant, console 2.0.0-beta, router 4.1.0. Change window 23:59-02:00 UTC. Canary plan: 3% x10m -> 15% x20m -> 50% x30m -> full. Wave id rw-17486. @maria runtime, @chris router, @jordan sre please ack blockers now.

maria: ack. Heads-up: runtime 3.5.0 enables async-kv scanner by default (ASYNC_KV=true) and a new memory compaction tweak. I want ASYNC_KV=false for initial canary to avoid interleaving latency spikes with new compaction. Can we target a runtime variant: 3.5.0-std-asyncoff?

chris: ack. Router has header compression enabled in 4.1.0 (COMPRESS_HEADERS=true). Console 2.0.0-beta advertises support for compressed headers but that beta flag is gated per-org. If console flag isn't flipped we should push router with COMPRESS_HEADERS=false for canary. Also note router image adds a new dialer that raised conn-establish time by ~15ms in staging.

jordan: thanks. New rules: runtime will use 3.5.0-std-asyncoff per @maria, router will deploy canary with COMPRESS_HEADERS=false. SRE will watch p50/p95/p99, generate latency, and 5xx. Abort if 5xx > 0.3% or p99 > 800ms. deploybot will handle ramps.

deploybot: wave rw-17486 queued. Canary config: {"canary_pct":3,"canary_stage_mins":[10,20,30],"abort_conds":["5xx>0.3%","p99>800ms","token_err_increase"]}

anA: small nit: console beta roll is scheduled for 01:30 UTC behind a feature flag. I'll hold the console UI rollout until we see canary green.

chris: running canary command with env override:
```
kubectl set env deploy/router-canary COMPRESS_HEADERS=false --namespace=prod-canary
```

deploybot: canary started at 00:01 UTC. Rolling api v2.8.0 -> ok, runtime 3.5.0-std-asyncoff -> ok, router 4.1.0 (COMPRESS_HEADERS=false) -> rolling to 3%.

deploybot: 3% reached at 00:10 UTC. Shortchecks: 200/200 on health, but noticing sporadic 502s from api frontends. Aggregating logs...

jordan: 502s, can we get a quick trace? SRE pls correlate.

sre-bot: tracing snapshot: several traces show router returning 502 when backend replied with compressed payload unexpected by api-proxy. p95 proxy deserialize time increased. No infra node failures. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/d/ops/release-watch?var=wave=rw-17486
- p50 baseline 140ms
- p95 baseline 350ms
- p99 baseline 760ms
- 5xx baseline 0.06%

maria: interesting, runtime looks fine on token latencies. The 502s seem upstream. Could router still be compressing some paths despite COMPRESS_HEADERS=false? chris can you double-check header logic and envoy filters?

chris: investigating. Found a mismatch: older edge RN config still sets encode_for_legacy=true which triggers compression on certain routes. I'll flip the router back to stable while we fix the filter. Suggest rollback router to 4.0.9 for canary subset.

ana: (note: console flagged) I won't flip console beta until router confirmed.

deploybot: initiating router rollback: deploybot rollback component=router target=4.0.9 wave=rw-17486 initiated_by=chris

deploybot: router rollback started at 00:22 UTC. Pausing ramp. Notifying stakeholders.

deploybot: router rollback complete at 00:28 UTC. Canary state: api+runtime at 3%, router reverted to 4.0.9, traffic shifted back through stable router. Re-evaluating health.

sre-bot: recheck after rollback: 5xx dropped back to 0.07%, p99 returned to 730ms, no residual errors. Marking canary paused_at_3% pending router filter fix.

jordan: good. Action items: 1) chris to patch router filter to respect COMPRESS_HEADERS flag and remove encode_for_legacy behavior from edge rules, 2) maria to run async-kv stress with compaction toggled in staging, 3) ana to coordinate console beta flip only after router fix. We'll reschedule next ramp after fix.

chris: filing PR for edge filter and will run a short staging validation.

maria: running extended runtime perf test in staging now with ASYNC_KV=true and compaction on to capture any interaction.

ana: will hold UI and notify product.

jordan: thanks team. We'll close this window out and pick a new slot after the fixes. Posting release notes update in the release doc and scheduling a follow-up preflight for 08:00 UTC next day. :raised_hands:
